name: Chocolat 系（こまど：Chocolat / Plum / Lime）
description: こまど的 Chocolat、Plum、Lime 共用的原生形态键（eye_blink_1_L、jitome_1_L、mouth_smile_1_L、eyebrow_angry_1_L 等），Lime 的不同拼写（eye_brink_1_L、A / U）作为备选名。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Native shape keys shared by Komado's Chocolat, Plum and Lime (eye_blink_1_L, jitome_1_L, mouth_smile_1_L, eyebrow_angry_1_L, ...); Lime's other spellings (eye_brink_1_L, A / U) are fallback names. Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: eyebrow_outer_up_L
channels.note: 眉毛上移（左侧）。最大位移 17.5mm（plum）。网格里没有 eyebrow_outer_up_L 时用 eyebrow_up_L。Plum 有 eyebrow_outer_up（只提眉尾）；Chocolat / Lime 用 eyebrow_up，整条眉毛上移
channels.note_en: Brow up (left). Max displacement 17.5 mm (plum). Uses eyebrow_up_L when the mesh has no eyebrow_outer_up_L. Plum has eyebrow_outer_up (outer brow only); Chocolat / Lime use eyebrow_up, the whole brow up

channels.name: eyebrow_outer_up_R
channels.note: 眉毛上移（右侧）。最大位移 17.5mm（plum）。网格里没有 eyebrow_outer_up_R 时用 eyebrow_up_R。Plum 有 eyebrow_outer_up（只提眉尾）；Chocolat / Lime 用 eyebrow_up，整条眉毛上移
channels.note_en: Brow up (right). Max displacement 17.5 mm (plum). Uses eyebrow_up_R when the mesh has no eyebrow_outer_up_R. Plum has eyebrow_outer_up (outer brow only); Chocolat / Lime use eyebrow_up, the whole brow up

channels.name: eyebrow_down_L
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 8.3mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 8.3 mm (plum)

channels.name: eyebrow_down_R
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 8.3mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 8.3 mm (plum)

channels.name: eyebrow_inner_up_L
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 10.8mm（plum）。仅 Plum 有
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 10.8 mm (plum). Plum only

channels.name: eyebrow_inner_up_R
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 10.8mm（plum）。仅 Plum 有
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 10.8 mm (plum). Plum only

channels.name: eyebrow_angry_1_L
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（左侧）。最大位移 17.6mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 17.6 mm (plum)

channels.name: eyebrow_angry_1_R
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 17.6mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 17.6 mm (plum)

channels.name: eye_blink_1_L
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 23.7mm（plum）。网格里没有 eye_blink_1_L 时用 eye_brink_1_L
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 23.7 mm (plum). Uses eye_brink_1_L when the mesh has no eye_blink_1_L

channels.name: eye_blink_1_R
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 23.7mm（plum）。网格里没有 eye_blink_1_R 时用 eye_brink_1_R
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 23.7 mm (plum). Uses eye_brink_1_R when the mesh has no eye_blink_1_R

channels.name: jitome_1_L
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 5.9mm（chocolat）。网格里没有 jitome_1_L 时用 eye_jito_1_L
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 5.9 mm (chocolat). Uses eye_jito_1_L when the mesh has no jitome_1_L

channels.name: jitome_1_R
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（右侧）。最大位移 5.9mm（chocolat）。网格里没有 jitome_1_R 时用 eye_jito_1_R
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 5.9 mm (chocolat). Uses eye_jito_1_R when the mesh has no jitome_1_R

channels.name: eye_surprise_L
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 1.0mm（plum）。形变很小（约 1mm）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 1.0 mm (plum). Very small deformation (about 1 mm)

channels.name: eye_surprise_R
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 1.0mm（plum）。形变很小（约 1mm）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 1.0 mm (plum). Very small deformation (about 1 mm)

channels.name: lower_eyelid_up_1_L
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 2.8mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 2.8 mm (plum)

channels.name: lower_eyelid_up_1_R
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 2.8mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 2.8 mm (plum)

channels.name: Option_cheek_puku-_L
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（左侧）。最大位移 3.6mm（chocolat）。网格里没有 Option_cheek_puku-_L 时用 cheek_puku-_L
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (left). Max displacement 3.6 mm (chocolat). Uses cheek_puku-_L when the mesh has no Option_cheek_puku-_L

channels.name: Option_cheek_puku-_R
channels.note: 脸颊鼓起（右侧）。最大位移 3.6mm（chocolat）。网格里没有 Option_cheek_puku-_R 时用 cheek_puku-_R
channels.note_en: Cheek puffed (right). Max displacement 3.6 mm (chocolat). Uses cheek_puku-_R when the mesh has no Option_cheek_puku-_R

channels.name: mouth_A_1
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 11.1mm（plum）。网格里没有 mouth_A_1 时用 A
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 11.1 mm (plum). Uses A when the mesh has no mouth_A_1

channels.name: mouth_U_1
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 6.4mm（plum）。网格里没有 mouth_U_1 时用 U。u 口型带张嘴
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 6.4 mm (plum). Uses U when the mesh has no mouth_U_1. "u" shape with the mouth open

channels.name: mouth_smile_1_L
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（左侧）。最大位移 1.4mm（plum）。网格里没有 mouth_smile_1_L 时用 mouth_smile_L
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (left). Max displacement 1.4 mm (plum). Uses mouth_smile_L when the mesh has no mouth_smile_1_L

channels.name: mouth_smile_1_R
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（右侧）。最大位移 1.4mm（plum）。网格里没有 mouth_smile_1_R 时用 mouth_smile_R
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (right). Max displacement 1.4 mm (plum). Uses mouth_smile_R when the mesh has no mouth_smile_1_R

channels.name: mouth_angry_1_L
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（左侧）。最大位移 1.5mm（plum）。网格里没有 mouth_angry_1_L 时用 mouth_angry_L
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (left). Max displacement 1.5 mm (plum). Uses mouth_angry_L when the mesh has no mouth_angry_1_L

channels.name: mouth_angry_1_R
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（右侧）。最大位移 1.5mm（plum）。网格里没有 mouth_angry_1_R 时用 mouth_angry_R
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (right). Max displacement 1.5 mm (plum). Uses mouth_angry_R when the mesh has no mouth_angry_1_R

channels.name: mouth_wide_L
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（左侧）。最大位移 4.5mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (left). Max displacement 4.5 mm (plum)

channels.name: mouth_wide_R
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（右侧）。最大位移 4.5mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (right). Max displacement 4.5 mm (plum)

channels.name: mouth_narrow_L
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（左侧）。最大位移 2.5mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (left). Max displacement 2.5 mm (plum)

channels.name: mouth_narrow_R
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（右侧）。最大位移 2.5mm（plum）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (right). Max displacement 2.5 mm (plum)

channels.name: mouth_position_L
channels.note: 嘴整体移向角色左侧。最大位移 3.3mm（plum）。仅 Plum 有
channels.note_en: Whole mouth to the character's left. Max displacement 3.3 mm (plum). Plum only

channels.name: mouth_position_R
channels.note: 嘴整体移向角色右侧。最大位移 3.3mm（plum）。仅 Plum 有
channels.note_en: Whole mouth to the character's right. Max displacement 3.3 mm (plum). Plum only

channels.name: mouth_up
channels.note: 嘴整体上移。最大位移 3.2mm（plum）。捏脸区的嘴位置键
channels.note_en: Whole mouth up. Max displacement 3.2 mm (plum). Mouth position key from the face-customization keys

channels.name: mouth_down
channels.note: 嘴整体下移。最大位移 4.6mm（plum）。捏脸区的嘴位置键
channels.note_en: Whole mouth down. Max displacement 4.6 mm (plum). Mouth position key from the face-customization keys

channels.name: eye_look_up_1
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 9.0mm（plum）。网格里没有 eye_look_up_1 时用 eye_look_up。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 9.0 mm (plum). Uses eye_look_up when the mesh has no eye_look_up_1. Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_look_down
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 9.8mm（plum）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 9.8 mm (plum). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_look_L
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 9.4mm（plum）。网格里没有 eye_look_L 时用 eye_look_left。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 9.4 mm (plum). Uses eye_look_left when the mesh has no eye_look_L. Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_look_R
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 9.4mm（plum）。网格里没有 eye_look_R 时用 eye_look_right。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 9.4 mm (plum). Uses eye_look_right when the mesh has no eye_look_R. Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
